before.title: Admitted lines
before.body: Моя русская кошка любит мою новую собаку — My Russian cat likes my new dog. этих женщин — I like these women.

after.title: Admitted lines
after.body: Моя русская кошка любит мою новую собаку — My Russian cat likes my new dog. The separate fragment этих женщин means these women. Its plural forms can be accusative or genitive; the source illustrates an animate accusative object. The fragment alone is not a complete sentence and supplies no predicate or first-person subject. The preceding complete cat and dog sentence has its own predicate; do not carry that meaning into the separate fragment.
